name: A Celestial Detour
source:
A mecha-pilot duo on their well-deserved vacation...until the spaceship carrying them crash-landed on an unfamiliar planet.

Now stranded, the crew and passengers must now embark on (an unexpectedly relaxing) road trip to the nearest launch pad that can take them home.

Get to know the colorful group of humans, cyborg, android, and aliens while navigating through unfamiliar food, old wounds, and and the looming threat of an intergalactic war.  

Make good memories, forge new friendships, and perhaps find that one love on this week-long journey along the beautiful coastline of Planet Apo.

[From [url=https://karita0101.itch.io/a-celestial-detour]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一对机甲驾驶员搭档原本正在享受当之无愧的假期……直到搭载他们的宇宙飞船迫降在了一颗陌生的星球上。

受困异星的船员与乘客们，不得不踏上一场（意外惬意悠闲的）公路旅行，前往最近的一处发射台设法回家。

在沿着阿波星壮美海岸线展开的为期一周的旅途中，结识由人类、改造人、仿生人与外星人组成的多彩同行队伍，共同面对陌生的异星美食、陈年旧伤，以及步步逼近的星际战争阴云。

留下美好回忆，缔结真挚友谊——说不定还能在这段旅途中邂逅命中注定的恋情。

[摘自[url=https://karita0101.itch.io/a-celestial-detour]itch.io[/url]]
